item.text:
The product title now appears as soon as the product page opens. Inventory and price load inside a Suspense boundary, with “Loading inventory...” shown in the meantime. I also enabled static shell prefetching for the [home link](/home/sandbox/workspace/app/page.tsx:7), so the [product title](/home/sandbox/workspace/app/product/page.tsx:18) is ready when the link is clicked.

`npm run build` passed. In a browser check with the live request delayed, the title and loading message appeared before the stock count.
